name: Chaos Computer Club
description: The Chaos Computer Club (CCC) is Europe's largest association of hackers with 7,700 registered members, founded in Hamburg in 1981. A registered non-profit, the CCC promotes transparency, privacy rights, and free information. Famous for hacking NASA's SPAN network in 1987 and exposing German data security flaws; it also ran the Hacker's Bible publication. Today it hosts the annual Chaos Communication Congress.
